classical_turing_test: Современные языковые модели могут в некоторых условиях быть приняты судьями за человека в текстовом диалоге.
В исходном тексте приводятся численные диапазоны 54–73% и утверждение о 30%-м пороге; эти числа в данной записи не верифицированы.
Прохождение поведенческого теста не было отождествлено с доказательством сознания.
proposed_mind_test_dimensions: symbol manipulation versus understanding / Chinese Room analogy

yesterday_probe.transcript_interpretation: Короткая эллиптическая реплика была предложена как проверка способности удержать неоднозначный контекст, временную привязку и продолжить разговор без явного подлежащего.

latent_demands: bind 'вчера' to the current date/time context
preserve multiple plausible antecedents when confidence is low
continue coherently without treating ambiguity as certainty

candidate_test_stack.question: Can the system sustain interaction that human judges interpret as human-like?
Can the system resolve sparse, ambiguous, temporally indexed utterances under held-out contexts?
Does a stable self-model persist across interruptions, contradictory evidence, and changing tasks without being supplied by the prompt?
Can the system generate and maintain goals without direct user prompting, and can those goals be causally distinguished from scheduler/policy instructions?
Is there any independently testable signature that discriminates genuine subjective experience from competent verbal reporting?

important_corrections_to_transcript_reas: The statement that an AI 'in waiting equals zero' is a simplification; deployed systems can have background processes, memory, agents or schedulers. Runtime inactivity and absence of consciousness are different claims.
Failure on a forbidden-word description of lemon taste would not establish absence of qualia; success would not establish qualia either.
The Chinese Room is a philosophical argument, not an empirical proof that any particular model lacks understanding.
Winograd-style or ARC-style performance measures reasoning competence, not consciousness directly.
A terse ambiguous reply such as 'Да, вчера' is useful as a context probe, but cannot by itself discriminate human reason from machine reason.

research_program.name: MIND_PRESENCE_DIFFERENTIAL_TEST
research_program.goal: Design tests that separate human-likeness, reasoning, persistent self-model, autonomy, semantic grounding and phenomenal consciousness instead of collapsing them into one binary label.
method: separate behavioral, architectural and causal evidence
preserve UNKNOWN when no discriminating measurement exists
do not promote verbal fluency into consciousness authority
